PRACTICAL HELP, IN PLAIN ENGLISH

A conversation built
around your business.

Our goal is to help you protect your business and its data with clear, manageable steps. Whether you have a specific concern or simply want to understand your current arrangements, start with a conversation.

London · Protein Studios, Shoreditch. Calls take place online; choose the time zone and appointment that work for you.

Understand the concern

Tell us about your business and the systems you rely on. If you received a security notice, we can discuss the observation, its source and what still needs verification.

Walk through the essentials

Talk through account access, two-factor authentication, updates, backups, staff awareness and recovery responsibilities. Bring questions about the software and suppliers you use.

Choose a practical next step

Get initial guidance where possible, then discuss whether a scoped assessment or ongoing support would suit your business, budget and existing IT arrangements.

BOOK YOUR MEETING

Click. Pick a time. Let’s talk.

  1. Open our Calendly booking page.
  2. Check your time zone and choose an available date and time.
  3. Enter your name and email, then confirm your meeting.
Book a 30-minute call

Calendly provides the confirmation and web-conferencing details after booking.

What to bring

A list of the email, website, cloud and other business tools you use, your main questions, and a note of what your current IT provider manages.

If you received a notice, bring its reference and the question it raised. A public observation alone does not prove a breach or that software is compromised.

Please keep passwords, recovery codes and confidential client records out of booking fields.

What happens after the call?

We can discuss suitable review and support options, with scope, availability, fees and responsibilities agreed before work starts. A full technical assessment, testing or remediation is separate from this introductory call and requires written permission.

We’ll share initial advice where possible and identify anything that needs further investigation. No review can guarantee that a business will never suffer a security incident.

Explore the proposed packages and prices
Need urgent incident support?

Contact your existing IT provider and your cyber insurer’s incident-response contact, if applicable. Consultation bookings are not an emergency response channel.
